name: YouTube (www.youtube.com)
description: YouTube as a capability surface (NOT an AI chat site): video search via the site's own results page and transcript read-back from the watch page's own transcript panel. No chat composer exists; no chat capability is registered.
author: ui2api capabilities
siteVersion: Polymer/Lit SPA (web components ytd-* shadow DOM); live-probed 2026-09-20 on real Chrome 152 (results list layout; structured-description modal; transcript panel login-gated)

transport.protocol: UI-driven only: real page loads (youtube.com/results?search_query=…) and clicks on the site's own buttons; answers read back off the rendered DOM. YouTube's internal innertube API (expected /youtubei/v1/*, unverified) is intentionally NOT driven directly — no fabricated traffic.

capabilities.name: Video search
capabilities.description: Load YouTube's own results page for a query (https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=<q>) and read the rendered result list (ytd-video-renderer rows, title link a#video-title — VERIFIED 2026-09-20 live round-trip: 11 results on probe query) back as {title, videoId, url, channel, metadata}.
capabilities.method: ui-path (real navigation to the site's results URL + DOM read-back; the site's own JS renders the results)

capabilities.name: Transcript read-back
capabilities.description: Open a watch page (youtube.com/watch?v=<id>), expand the description (tp-yt-paper-button#expand), click the site's own 'Show transcript' button (button[aria-label="Show transcript"]), and read the transcript panel segments (ytd-transcript-segment-renderer). UI path VERIFIED 2026-09-20 to the network gate: the site's own get_transcript call answers HTTP 400 'Precondition check failed' for ANONYMOUS sessions — segments require a logged-in session.lock.json capture; full read-back NOT yet verified.
capabilities.method: ui-path (navigate + click the site's own transcript toggle + DOM read-back)

capabilities.name: Post a comment
capabilities.description: VERBATIM studio surface (comment) — LOGIN-GATED + public + irreversible. Registry contract: workType ui|js + reloadAfterSuccess. IMPLEMENTED (dispatch lives on /capability/youtube 2026-09-21): opens the watch page's own composer (ytd-comment-simplebox-renderer #placeholder-area), types via real key events, presses the site's own submit button, then reads the text back off the page's comment list. Honest: anonymous user hitting the comment composer gets YouTube's sign-in interstitial; ok:false login-required until an authorized captured logged-in session exists. NEVER posts without it.
capabilities.status: implemented-dom-unverified (auth required; status open pending a live round-trip on a captured logged-in session)

capabilities.name: Like a video
capabilities.description: IMPLEMENTED (dispatch on /capability/youtube 2026-09-21): clicks the site's own ytd-segmented-like-dislike-button-renderer like button on the watch page and reads back the pressed state (aria-pressed/label). Reversible (action=unlike). Ok:false login-required until an authorized captured session. Never fabricates a like.
capabilities.status: implemented-dom-unverified (auth required; status open pending a live round-trip on a captured logged-in session)

capabilities.name: Subscribe to a channel
capabilities.description: IMPLEMENTED (dispatch on /capability/youtube 2026-09-21): clicks the site's own ytd-subscribe-button-renderer button on a channel page and reads back the button label flip. Reversible. Ok:false login-required until an authorized captured session.
capabilities.status: implemented-dom-unverified (auth required; status open pending a live round-trip on a captured logged-in session)

capabilities.name: Upload a video (Studio)
capabilities.description: Upload video to YouTube (youtube.com/upload) — LOGIN-GATED + public + IRREVERSIBLE. IMPLEMENTED (dispatch on /capability/youtube 2026-09-21): hands a local file to the site's own hidden input[type=file] via setInputFiles and reads back the page's processing state. Ok:false until an authorized logged-in session + real file. NEVER publishes a video without it.
capabilities.status: implemented-dom-unverified (auth required; status open pending a live round-trip on a captured logged-in session + real file)

capabilities.name: Add to a playlist
capabilities.description: IMPLEMENTED (dispatch on /capability/youtube 2026-09-21): opens the watch page's Save menu (button[aria-label^='Save']) and reads back whether the account's playlist choices rendered; no add is committed until a choice is made. Ok:false login-required until an authorized captured session.
capabilities.status: implemented-dom-unverified (auth required; status open pending a live round-trip on a captured logged-in session)

auth.note: Search and (in most regions) transcript are available anonymously. Optional: capture a real session (ui2api profile capture "https://www.youtube.com") so consent walls are pre-answered and region/age restrictions reflect the user's account. No token extraction performed; no wire auth observed.

permissions: drives www.youtube.com in the user's own browser session (real page loads + real clicks only)
reads only what the page itself renders (result titles, transcript panel text)
respects YouTube ToS posture: no scraping of internal APIs, no download of media streams
builtinProfile: none — YouTube is not a chat site; no ChatDriver profile entry (see REGISTER.md)
analysisMethod: live DOM probe on attached real Chrome 152 (CDP attach, launchBrowser UI2API_ATTACH_PORT=9222): youtube_search fully verified (list results, 11 rows); youtube_transcript UI path verified to the site's own get_transcript call, which is login-gated (HTTP 400 Precondition check failed, anonymous session — logged-in capture required for segment read-back)
